entries.b5befdc46a7b4a1e: Since August 2016, three of its fee-based nursing care homes, HIKARI HEIGHTS-VARUS Ishiyama, Tsukisamu Koen, and Fujino, have been designated to provide short-term stay daily life care, and they accept short stays on a 24-hour basis.

entries.c69818590362b6e3: Since its founding in 1986, the company has a track record of operating paid nursing homes in Hokkaido, and some of its care-included facilities have a dedicated care wing and a nurse on site 24 hours a day. Under the lump-sum entrance fee system, it has a right-of-use arrangement that allows residents to keep living there after the amortization period until the contract ends, and it is characterized by a support system with continuity between medical care and nursing care, including coordination with an affiliated clinic.
entries.d0a4553d802de0a1: Elderly people who require rooms dedicated to care
entries.d22a0b03e109870c: The company operates two facilities in Sapporo: Varus Cuore Sapporo Kita and Varus Cuore Minami 19-jo 2. These are residential facilities with living support services, and residents who require care may choose to receive care services from external providers and live independently. The land and buildings are leased.
entries.d3ea85f189138dc7: In the nursing care industry, demand for care services is growing with the increase in the elderly population, while structural labor shortages caused by the decline in the working-age population have become severe. The company operates 12 facilities and offices in Hokkaido and positions itself as the leading company in Hokkaido's paid nursing home industry, but its business base is concentrated in Hokkaido.
entries.da7718fa9d39fca9: Elderly people receiving care at home and their families
entries.decc49ae2d274ce2: The company operates Varus Cuore Otaru in Otaru City and Masters Varus Hokkaido Ballpark, which opened in June 2024 within the Hokkaido Ballpark F Village in Kitahiroshima City. It provides living support services, meal services and care services, and the land and buildings are leased. Varus Cuore Otaru is designated as a specified facility for resident living care (preventive care).
entries.e30a0f0ff2c97045: The average occupancy rate for the current fiscal year was about 80.3%, short of the target of 95% or more. Masters Varus Hokkaido Ballpark, which opened in June 2024, is still working toward full occupancy, and boosting occupancy at existing facilities and raising occupancy at new facilities are the keys to stabilizing the earnings base in the near term.
entries.e5313425bd483c89: At Sapporo Minami Day Service Center in Minami-ku, Sapporo, the company provides day care services and first-category day service business, offering bathing, daily motion training, recreation and other services. The service started in July 2016.
entries.e7e7b864ec3f2ab2: It operates 6 facilities in Sapporo: Hikari Heights Varus Ishiyama, Tsukisamu Koen, Fujino, Kotoni, Makomanai Koen and Varus Cuore Yamanote. All facilities are designated for specified facility residential care (preventive care) under long-term care insurance, and the company's staff provide care services on a 24-hour basis. Kotoni and Makomanai Koen have attached care-only buildings, and at both of these facilities and at Varus Cuore Yamanote, nurses are stationed 24 hours a day. In addition, Kotoni and Makomanai Koen provide care services in cooperation with attached clinics. The land and buildings of the 6 facilities were securitized in April 2013 and are now leased.
entries.eaf6dda5c020927a: Since August 2016, the 3 fee-based nursing homes with care, Hikari Heights Varus Ishiyama, Tsukisamu Koen and Fujino, have been designated for short-term stay daily life care and accept short stays on a 24-hour basis. It began this in order to meet the needs of families supporting elderly people requiring care at home in areas where the population is aging.
entries.f0f4297e88a6f7a1: In Sapporo, the company operates 6 care-included paid nursing homes, 2 residential-type paid nursing homes and 2 serviced housing facilities for elderly people, as well as other facilities, and provides care and daily-living support services around the clock, 24 hours a day.
